title: pm daily scratchpad 2026-04-05
content:
TODO / notes for today (quick, rough)

Big picture: launch window for hosted v1.3 feature flags on 2026-04-12. Focus today: finalize PRD edits, lock rollout plan, confirm infra playbook with SRE, and sync design for banner + error states.

Morning priorities
- PRD edits: address feedback from product review (Marta) — action: add rollback criteria and latency SLOs section. (estimate 60-90m)
- Stakeholder follow-ups: Engineering (David Chen) on KV cache migration risk + SRE (Samir) on autoscaler limits.
- Launch checklist: finish canary config, monitoring dashboards, and runbook draft.

Meetings
- 10:00 — Eng sync (David, Devon): confirm timeline for model-variant rollout. Notes: David ok with canary on 4/10 -> scale to 25% then 4/12 full. Need migration window for KV cache (see action items).
- 11:30 — SRE runbook review (Samir, Priya): requested explicit throttling thresholds and fallback to smaller model variant. Samir to add Prometheus alert IDs by EOD.
- 15:00 — Design quick sync (Marta): banner copy + error treatment. Agreed on concise error copy and 'Try again' CTA. Assets due 4/07.

PRD edits (things to add/change)
- Rollback criteria: if 99th pctl latency increases by >30% for 10min OR error rate >1% for 5min, auto-roll back to previous model.
- Canary strategy: 5% (4/10 morning) -> 25% (4/10 afternoon) -> 100% (4/12) with health checks every 5m.
- Monitoring: add token-level cost chart, 99th pctl latency, error rate, and prefix cache hit ratio.
- Security: confirm KMS key rotation window with infra team (Devon).

Action items (owner, due)
- Aisha: update PRD with rollback + monitoring section (due 2026-04-06)
- David Chen: KV cache migration plan + migration window options (due 2026-04-07)
- Samir Patel: add Prometheus alert IDs and playbook for throttling (due 2026-04-05 EOD)
- Marta Lopez: final banner + error UI assets (due 2026-04-07)
- Devon Kim: validate autoscaler settings for Dedicated pools and confirm mem/cpu headroom (due 2026-04-06)
- QA (TBD): test plan for canary (test cases + acceptance criteria) — need to assign by 4/06

Risks / Open questions
- KV cache migration: risk of cold-start latency spike — mitigation: staged warmup and short-lived traffic shaping during canary. Need dev + infra to agree on warmup script.
- Autoscaler: if scale-up latency >30s we might get tail latency spikes under load. Samir to confirm SLOs and mitigation.
- Billing impact: token-level cost increase expected with larger model variant; finance wants an estimate for top 10 customers before launch. Action: request quick cost delta from infra (Devon).

Launch checklist (high level)
- [ ] PRD final + approvals (Marta, Eng lead)
- [ ] Runbook + Playbooks in Confluence (SRE + PM)
- [ ] Canary config in infra + smoke tests
- [ ] Dashboards (prod) and alert thresholds
- [ ] Customer comms draft (CS) — coordinate with Claire
- [ ] Rollout gating: automated health checks + manual approval step

Notes to self
- Keep PRD terse; move deep technical notes to appendix or Confluence runbook.
- Capture any post-launch rollback timeline and customer notification template.
- Follow up with finance on cost estimate; add to Friday sync agenda if delayed.

Linked quick refs
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1248 (prerelease runbook draft)
- Jira: PROD-8421 (canary tasks), INFRA-7690 (autoscaler tuning)
- GitHub: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/234 (canary config PR)
